nom: SUNGBOON EDITOR Deep Collagen Power Boosting Overnight Sheet Mask

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or winter-affected skin report the mask soothes dry patches, adds lasting hydration, and one uses it for naturally dry skin and dry climate.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation, no burning, and no breakouts, while others report severe redness, swelling, cystic pimples, or bumpy skin requiring return of the product.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 55+ report visibly smoother fine lines, less noticeable wrinkles, and tighter-looking skin, including around crow's feet and eyelids.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers citing fine lines, wrinkles, or crow's feet report visible smoothing or reduced appearance overnight or with weekly use, including on eyelids and forehead lines; effects are described as temporary by one reviewer.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report significant hydration, plumping, and relief of dry patches, especially with overnight use in dry or winter conditions; one reviewer felt it hydrated less well than a prior brand used.
concerns.redness: One reviewer's cheek redness reportedly calmed after a few uses, but others report new redness, bumps, or a swollen, sore, stinging reaction after wearing the mask.
concerns.barrier: One self-described tough-skinned reviewer with no history of product reactions reports severe swelling, puffiness, stinging, and redness lasting hours after overnight use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports numerous new pimples and severe redness after a few hours' wear; another reports no new breakouts despite sensitive skin.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer describes cystic, painful breakouts severe enough to return the product, despite others with sensitive skin reporting no breakouts at all.
concerns.oiliness: No reviews specifically address oiliness or oil control.

aspects.libelle: Severe reaction with swelling or redness

extraits.texte: I have very tough skin. I dont have reactions to sny products. Even professional chemical peels do not cause redness or sensitivity. I wore this mask overnight and woke up to the most swollen and puffy face. My face stings and I have giant bags under my eyes. I took an allergy pill to help the swelling go down. It has been 7 hours very red, sore and swollen. I would never recommend this product.

If you have sensitive skin, this mask might not be for you. Tried it for a few hours to see how it would set before trying overnight. My cheeks are now extremely red and bumpy with numerous pimples the day after.

I wanted to love this, but after using it, it broke me out so bad with cystic painful zits that I had to return it. I do have sensitive skin though, so this happens when using something new sometimes. Unfortunately, not for me.

I have been using these masks for months and love them. They are very plumping and leave ny skin moisturized and super soft. In addition, they do not bother my sensitive skin. I would not leave over 3 hours because if the dry out too much on your face your skin could get irritated when you peel them off, as they do stick well when the dry, but definitely leave on at least 2-3 hours to see the full effect. I highly recommend Sungboon Editor masks!

I dont have a ton to compare it too, but i wore the first mask for over an hour and my skin feels wonderful. It's definitely helped tighten my crows feet. My skin feels healthier. Cheaper than a facial! My skin is extremely sensitive and this mask didnt upset it at all. No burning, no redness, no breakouts. If i even hold a phone to my face my skin goes nuts. So this is great! No strong over stimulating smells eithers. It's absolutely worth the try. 6 masks included. I plan on wearing one at bedtime a couple times a week. I liked it that much.

Biodance is good, but SBEDT is better. I find the skin plumping, smoothing and glow does last longer. My favorite is the Vit C SBEDT mask but this one is good too! I use it once or twice a week due to my naturally dry skin, dry climate & winter season.

This is one of the best masks I've ever used. It's nice and thick and stays in place easily and the results left me speechless. I'm 55 with good skin but have some deeper lines that bug me. I wore this mask to bed and was amazed at how much less noticeable these lines were in the morning from this mask. It was unbelievable!
